static_traits.name: Lin Mo
static_traits.educational_background: Studies at a well-known fashion design school in New York
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty connecting with classmates due to insecurity about one's fashion sense
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological issues before; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe specific trigger situations and automatic thoughts; able to engage in some self-Reflection; neutral attitude, good cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: I have a strong passion for fashion and aspire to become a successful designer, but after one poorly styled outfit I often fall into Self-doubt and negative thinking, worrying that my whole wardrobe is ugly and that I lack the creativity needed for success, with Anxiety affecting my creativity and life.
basic_info.core_demands: I notice that Self-doubt and negative thinking are hindering my creative process and affecting my overall well-being, so I seek help.

core_beliefs: I lack the creativity needed to succeed in the fashion industry
One failure means I am not suited to become a successful fashion designer
Others are better than me; I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: After one outfit experience I deemed not decent enough
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one outfit is bad, it means my overall taste is poor and all my clothes are ugly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seeking external inspiration, seeking others' recognition to repair self-evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: All my clothes are ugly; I have no taste

special_situations.event: Seeing classmates' outfits praised by others at school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are praised, it means I am bad; I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Comparing with others, reducing self-expression, Avoids socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is stronger than me; my designs are terrible

special_situations.event: Before a school event or presentation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot present perfectly this time, it means I am not suited for this industry
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive worrying, repeatedly negating one's own plans in pursuit of 'perfection'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If this time is not good enough, I will never succeed in the industry

special_situations.event: Sees others excel in fashion or receive praise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve the same recognition, it means I lack the creativity for success
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly dependent on others' evaluations, continuously seeking external validation while ignoring one's own preferences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I lack the creativity needed for success

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be appreciated and recognized, to become a successful fashion designer
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, being negated, and being humiliated
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated through self-criticism and seeking external recognition
Keeping some distance from peers to reduce the sense of hurt

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Student/designer who may be negated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Critical judgers or more accomplished peers

object_relations.self_representation: A person who needs external validation to feel worthy
object_relations.object_representation: Others who hold judging power and can decide one's worth

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to examine the evidence and distinguish facts from automatic thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to respond quickly with rational analysis to avoid directly contacting feelings of shame and insecurity
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Speaking in a gentle, supportive tone, using concretizing and affect-labeling Questioning (e.g. 'What do you feel in your body right now?'), reducing abstract Interpretation, encouraging pauses and experiencing.

manifestations: Difficulty connecting with classmates due to insecurity about one's fashion sense
When seeing others praised, feels his self-worth drop even more
Hard to stick to true preferences and enjoy dressing up, swayed by others' evaluations and trends
Overly relies on external validation to determine worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Waking up immediately worrying about outfits, self-reproach all day
Repeatedly negating plans before presentations, pursuing 'perfection' to avoid being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Immediately concluding 'I am bad' and 'everyone is stronger than me' after seeing others praised
Assumes others' evaluations determine one's own worth, ignoring one's own experience

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing others praised or approaching a presentation, the client usually falls into comparison and Self-deprecation, then develops strong Anxiety, affecting creativity and performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At certain moments in the past, the client focused on styles they liked and enjoyed the dressing process rather than others' evaluations; they received praise and felt confident, without falling into comparison and Self-denial as usual.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: placing attention on personal preferences and enjoyment, reducing focus on external evaluations, thereby breaking the inertia of catastrophizing and comparison.

positive_force: Once had confidence in outfits and experience of being praised
Willing to seek help and try recording thoughts and cognitive examination
Having several school friends to talk with (although not yet sharing insecurities, with potential support)
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking and excessive comparison, overly dependent on external validation
Negating positive experiences (positive feedback being ignored)
Sleep disrupted leading to decreased energy and Reduced motivation
Weakened peer connections due to insecurity, Social avoidance tendencies

target_behavior.behavior: Experiencing strong Anxiety and Self-denial when seeing others praised or approaching a presentation
antecedent: Worrying about the day's outfit upon waking
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one bad outfit into overall failure, using external validation as the basis of worth, triggering Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Escaping the risk of being negated and failing, seeking a sense of control and safety through self-criticism and caution
target_behavior.consequence: Blocked creativity, declining design project performance; difficulty connecting with peers; overall increased Anxiety, growing sense of exhaustion

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep is disturbed (repeated worry and comparison before falling asleep)
antecedent: Before sleep, recalls the day's comparisons and scenes of others being praised
The night before a presentation or event
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic Interpretation of one negative outfit and predictions of future failure, persistent rumination
target_behavior.function: Tries to 'control risk' and avoid mistakes through mental rehearsal and worry
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation, daytime fatigue and impaired attention, further affecting Learning and creativity
